tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Shape.
tour.welcome.body: A quick tour of where everything lives — about 30 seconds.
tour.home.title: Your day, at a glance.
tour.home.body: Your next move, meals and habits — all on the home screen.
tour.train.title: Today’s session.
tour.train.body: Your workout, ready to start — written by your coach, or built by you. Coach optional.
tour.eat.title: Meals & logging.
tour.eat.body: Your plan for the day. Tap a meal to log it in one tap.
tour.grocery.title: Grocery lists.
tour.grocery.body: Your week’s meals become a shopping list, sorted by aisle — auto-built for you.
tour.habits.title: Daily habits.
tour.habits.body: Check off the small things that add up — every one feeds your Shape Score.
tour.chat.title: Coaches & community.
tour.chat.body: Message your coaches and see the community feed.
tour.you.title: Your profile.
tour.you.body: Your living profile — climb, signals and everything you’ve earned.
tour.progress.title: Trends & PRs.
tour.progress.body: Weight, strength, sleep, volume — your whole picture, charted.
tour.goal.title: What you’re shaping toward.
tour.goal.body: Targets, milestones and your ETA — the contract you set with yourself.
tour.score.title: Your Shape Score.
tour.score.body: The one number that tells the truth — earn it, spend it, climb the tiers.
tour.radio.title: Shape Radio.
tour.radio.body: Ad-free mixes. Free with your membership.
score.intro: One number for showing up. Everything you log feeds it — and it climbs as you stay consistent. Here’s the gist.
score.tiers.head: Climb the tiers
score.tiers.body: Earn points to climb — and your tier never goes down once you reach it.
score.earn.head: Ways to earn
score.earn.compoundsBody: — hold your momentum and the weekly bonus grows. Your Score page lists every way to earn.
score.spend.head: Spend what you earn
score.spend.body: Turn points into real rewards — session credit, gear and more — in the Shape Store. Spending never lowers your rank.
score.protect.head: Protect your points
score.protect.body: Stay consistent to keep them. Skip a committed check-in or workout and the number dips a little — a coach can always waive it, and you never drop below 0.

coaching.title: Are you looking for personal coaching?
coaching.body: A coach builds your plan and checks in with you. You can add one any time, and the app works without one. If you want a coach, a short health screening comes next, so they can train you safely.
health.parq.heart: Has a doctor ever said you have a heart condition and that you should only do activity recommended by a doctor?
health.parq.chestActive: Do you feel pain in your chest when you do physical activity?
health.parq.chestRest: In the past month, have you had chest pain while not doing physical activity?
health.parq.dizzy: Do you lose your balance because of dizziness, or do you ever lose consciousness?
health.parq.joint: Do you have a bone or joint problem that could be made worse by a change in your physical activity?
health.parq.bpMeds: Is a doctor currently prescribing medication for your blood pressure or a heart condition?
health.parq.other: Do you know of any other reason why you should not do physical activity?
health.introHire: Before you hire a coach, a quick safety screen (PAR-Q). It is shared with the coaches you hire, so they can program safely around your history, and checkout carries on once it is saved.
health.intro: A quick safety screen (PAR-Q) before training starts. It lives on your profile and is shared with the coaches you hire — so they can program safely around your history.
health.flaggedNote: You answered yes to a screening question — talk with your doctor before becoming much more physically active. Your coach will see this and program accordingly.
health.rxQuestion: Are you currently taking any prescription medication(s)?
health.allergyQuestion: Do you have any allergies (food, medication, or other)?
health.pregnancyQuestion: Are you currently pregnant, or have you given birth in the past 6 months?
health.conditionsMore: Anything else your coach should know
health.conditionsPlaceholder: e.g. Type 2 diabetes — diet-managed · exercise-induced asthma
health.injuriesLabel: Injuries & surgeries · helps your coach program safely
health.injuriesPlaceholder: e.g. Left knee ACL repair 2022 · lower-back tightness
health.consent: I confirm these answers are accurate, and I understand they are shared with coaches I hire on Shape for my safety.
health.incomplete: Answer all required screening questions to continue
